title: Top-Degree Rank dim_Q R_12(F) = 1751 for the Three-Chain Sextic Jacobian Algebra and Independence from Contained Planes

description: Proof that for the smooth three-chain sextic fourfold X = V(F) ⊂ P^5 with F = Σ(x_i^5 x_{i+3} + x_{i+3}^6) containing the plane Π = V(x3,x4,x5), the partial derivatives form a regular sequence with dim J(F) = 25^3 = 15,625, Hilbert series (1+t+t^2+t^3+t^4)^6, and Griffiths primitive middle piece dim R_12(F) = 1751 (h^{2,2}(X) = 1752), identical to a very general smooth sextic fourfold.
